name: Fire Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 Fire damage; sets unattended flammable objects alight.
text: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object within range. On a hit it takes 1d10 Fire damage, and a flammable object that nobody is wearing or carrying catches fire. The damage becomes 2d10 at character level 5, 3d10 at level 11 and 4d10 at level 17.
